verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that an API endpoints overview exists, covering API-key and Bearer-token authentication. Nothing shows an interactive reference or runnable 'try it' examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes at every candidate path returned 404. A plain API docs page is adjacent to this story, not the interactive, runnable reference it asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
